questions.questionText: A business absorbs its overheads on the basis of machine hours. The following information is provided. actual budgeted overheads $960000 $900000 machine hours 6200 6000 By how much were overheads under-absorbed or over-absorbed?

options.B: (total fixed costs + total variable costs) divided by contribution to sales ratio
